## Computer-Use Agents For CAE Applications


Pete Klein


November 12, 2026


Engineers can now accelerate design and simulation cycles by utilizing agents to operate within CAE software. With Rescale Desktop and software connectors, agents can now operate your design and simulation software locally using your intent, your knowledge and your standards. Instead of just suggesting the next step and waiting for an engineer to act, agents can now autonomously interpret instructions, plan the work, operate the software and deliver a finished output for review by an engineer.


Explore Rescale Desktop with software connectors for Agentic Engineering.
